raw_response:
Most likely diagnosis: Primary hypothyroidism.

The findings supporting this are: classic hypothyroid symptoms, high tsh with low free t4, positive anti-tpo.

Other possibilities to consider include depression, subclinical hypothyroidism, central (secondary) hypothyroidism.

Recommendation: confirm the diagnosis with the appropriate investigations, start guideline-based management and arrange senior review.
